chunks: And whatever is in it from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, I have narrated it from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amir, from his uncle 'Abdullah ibn 'Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad, from al-Fadl ibn Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, from his father Isma'il ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ الْهَاشِمِيّ: Isma'il ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi, the final named transmitter in this chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal term of hadith narration
key_terms.عَمِّهِ: His uncle; identifies a family link in the chain of narrators
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father; indicates filial transmission within the sanad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Isma'il ibn al-Fadl in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi. Its significance is in documenting the route of transmission in hadith literature, clarifying the source lineage for reports included in the book.
